title: UPDATE: Nvidia Trades Chip Financing for Cut of Customer Revenue
summary:
Certain AI chip buyers are resisting new contractual terms that allow Nvidia to collect a portion of their earnings in exchange for financial assistance. The company is restructuring its AI Compute Partnership to swap traditional rental guarantees for a slice of its customers' cloud revenue to help them secure the capital and power needed to sustain hardware orders. The Information reports that these changes have sparked concerns among clients regarding a deeper dependence on the chipmaker.

The $500B financing initiative is managed by Vice President Nico Caprez, who joined the company 2.5 years ago and recently married CEO Jensen Huang's daughter, Madison. Caprez oversees multibillion dollar relationships with neocloud providers and serves as a consigliere to Huang. Reporting based on interviews with more than 12 employees indicates that Caprez is also tasked with converting GPUs into recognized financial assets.
